import re, sys
pre = open(sys.argv[1]).read().split()
out = open(sys.argv[2]).read().splitlines()
hw = {"tests/integration/test_coordinator.py::test_real_heterogeneous_fleet_cpu_and_gpu", "tests/unit/test_zero_bubble.py::test_store_is_seen_by_device_backward_threads"}
ok_skip = re.compile(r"SKIPPED \[1\] tests/(integration/test_coordinator|unit/test_zero_bubble)\.py:\d+: the hardware switch is gpu: false \(agents-architetura/tools/factory/hardware\.json\)$")
passed, bad, skipped = set(), [], []
for l in out:
    m = re.match(r"PASSED (\S+?)(\[[^\]]*\])?$", l)
    if m:
        passed.add(m.group(1))
    if re.match(r"(FAILED|ERROR|XFAIL|XPASS) ", l):
        bad.append(l)
    if l.startswith("SKIPPED "):
        skipped.append(l)
want = (set(pre) | set(sys.argv[3:])) - hw
missing = sorted(want - passed)
bad += [l for l in skipped if not ok_skip.match(l)]
print(f"SUITE_PASSED={len(passed)} WANT={len(want)} MISSING={len(missing)} SKIPPED={len(skipped)}")
for x in missing[:30]:
    print("NOT_PASSED", x)
for x in bad[:30]:
    print("BAD", x)
sys.exit(0 if not missing and not bad and len(skipped) == 2 else 1)
